# The Longmont Leader

> > Local news and community coverage for Longmont, Colorado, covering Boulder County events, education, business, and regional developments.

The Longmont Leader serves as Longmont's primary source for hyperlocal journalism, covering city council decisions, school district news, business developments, and community events. The publication provides comprehensive coverage of Boulder County and surrounding areas including Broomfield, Weld County, and regional Colorado news.
